# FDG9096

> CONSIDER implementing `IQueryable<T>` when access to the query expression, passed to members of `IQueryable`, is necessary.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.6.4 Supporting LINQ through IQueryable&lt;T>.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: whether access to the query expression is necessary, as for a remote data source, is a judgment.

## From the book

When querying potentially large data sets generated by remote processes or machines, it might be beneficial to execute the query remotely. An example of such a data set is a database, a directory service, or a Web service.
